45.
Any person who contravenes the provisions of this
Act or any rule made thereunder, commits an offence and
shall on conviction after summary trial before a Magistrate
be  liable  to  a  fine  not  exceeding  one  hundred  thousand
rupees or to imprisonment for a term not exceeding one year
or to both such fine and imprisonment.

46.
Any  person  convicted  for  an  offence  under  the
provisions  of  this  Act  shall  not  be  precluded  from  being
